reconstruction.scope: Individual Freiburg Minster: single stepped west tower with recessed pointed portal, red/white geometric clocks, open octagonal belfry and porous stone lattice spire; long red-tiled nave and higher polygonal east choir/chapel ring, large pointed aisle/clerestory glazing, geometric tracery, flying buttresses and pinnacles. Distinct Romanesque transept rose/round windows and low Renaissance arcade; two smaller eastern cock turrets with stone cones. Shared sandstone/ashlar/tile/wood, linear tints and metric UVs. Standard terrain foundations; no global flattening.
